text1: This is a custom modification of a low-tech Khopesh bomber hull. Ophira gained better speed, durability and payload.

The design of this particular fighter is based on a well-known Thunder heavy interceptor. Vasari is tuned for the direct assault of low-to-medium armoured targets and is quite potent at overloading enemy shields. Moreover, it is quite sturdy too, as it boasts a formidable armour, a compact shield generator and a flare launcher.

This hull is the result of a dedicated campaign aimed at creating a modern and fast cruiser-sized combat freighter. Creating a new design from scratch cost more resources than Chorna LLC could allocate at that time; therefore, the Kramar-class combat freighter is based on a famous dedicated missile cruiser called Gryphon. They both share a lot of doctrinal and structural similarities, but Kramar-class combar freighter emphasises staying out of direct combat while being able to defend itself by an array of missile weapons and point-defence mounts, contributing to battle with its complementary custom fighter wing. Its main system takes advantage of vast capabilities presented by the ship's autoforge, refitted for fighter chassis production; therefore, it is able to field more external firepower than it seems at first glance. The ship is basically a high-quality retrofit of another vessel, so there are some design compromises limiting its potential. However, one might further improve its carrier side by dedicating more hangar space used primarily by hauliers and other support and logistics craft to house another fighter wing. Surprisingly, the resulting combination of traits also makes it a great raid support vessel: its rather large cargo hold can be used for transporting military equipment, while an array of light-calibre point-defence weaponry can provide cover for numerous strike craft.

The so-called Ministry of Technological Standards strongly disapproves of such an approach to developing superior weaponry but was unable to confiscate it. According to a few remaining reports of the incident, the weapon had suddenly become "alive" moments before so-called "inspectors" were unalived.
